decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a cheap complement to the flooring range, and two years of presence do not yet show that its value will fail to materialize, so the option stays open.
The maintenance oil line anchors the surface-treatment offer for oiled floors at low holding cost, and no negative evidence has emerged that would justify abandoning it.
The care products for oiled floors build directly on the established offer and cost little to keep listed, so retaining them preserves upside while demand becomes clearer.
Although the firm already pruned one underlay (E), the moisture-protection underlay meets a distinct installer need, and keeping it costs little.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's business in a growing industry, so further commitment is far more likely than abandonment.
